verdict.rationale: The firm says it represents more venture funds than any other law firm and cites investor-side mandates, such as the lead investors in Anthropic's Series H and Addition and Lux Capital in the Hugging Face sale. It also reports heavy company-side volume (1,600+ financings since 2023; PitchBook's most active VC law firm for 12 years), so it clearly works both sides of the table. The claim that this gives it insight into current market terms is only implied, though, and all evidence is vendor-sourced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of market-terms insight (e.g., deal-terms data or reports), independent corroboration of the fund/investor-side practice.
